novel_features.name: Basket by text
novel_features.description: Add a product by id or by plain words; the CLI picks the best match in your market and adds it.
novel_features.rationale: Search, ranking and the CSRF-protected basket call run as one step; the web shop needs three screens.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it when a customer names an item in their own words.

novel_features.name: Earliest pickup slot
novel_features.description: The first free pickup slot of your market in one call.
novel_features.rationale: Parses the slot JSON embedded in the shop's calendar widget.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to propose a pickup time before ordering.

novel_features.name: Checkout with confirmation gate
novel_features.description: Preview the order (slot, payment, items, total) and place it only with --confirm.
novel_features.rationale: Walks the shop's checkout steps over HTTP and stops before the final button unless confirmed.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it after the customer said yes to the preview.

novel_features.name: Shopping list to basket
novel_features.description: Add many free-text lines with quantities at once and see what matched.
novel_features.rationale: Runs best-match resolution per line against the market's search.
novel_features.example: edeka-pp-cli list add milch butter '2x kaffee' --dry-run
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it for a whole shopping list from one message.

novel_features.name: Offer check for staples
novel_features.description: Which of these items are on offer in your market this week.
novel_features.rationale: Reads the offer badge on search hits per term in one call.
novel_features.example: edeka-pp-cli deals check milch kaffee butter --market doerflinger-ulm --json
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to tell the customer about offers on their usual items.

novel_features.name: Price history
novel_features.description: Prices an article had over time in your markets, from your own searches and offer lookups.
novel_features.rationale: Every search and offers call records prices in a local SQLite store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to judge whether an offer is really cheap.

novel_features.name: Compare markets
novel_features.description: The same search on several EDEKA markets side by side.
novel_features.rationale: Each EDEKA market runs its own shop; only a client that speaks all of them can compare.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it when the customer can choose between nearby markets.

narrative.headline: Shop your local EDEKA market from the terminal or an agent: offers, basket by text, earliest pickup slot, checkout with a confirmation gate.
narrative.value_prop: Works with every market on edeka.shop by its subdomain. Markets, offers and product search need no login; basket, slots and checkout use your imported browser session, which renews itself through the shop's one-year remember-me cookie.
narrative.auth_narrative: EDEKA has no public API. Log in to your market's shop (https://<market>.edeka.shop) once in a browser, then run 'edeka-pp-cli auth import --cdp http://127.0.0.1:<port>' or 'auth import --file cookies.json'. The CLI keeps the cookies in a session file (EDEKA_SESSION_FILE overrides the path) and renews the shop session through the remember-me cookie oxid_1. When that cookie is gone, commands exit with code 4: log in again and re-import.

quickstart.comment: find EDEKA markets near a postal code
basket by text (needs an imported session)

troubleshoots.fix: Log in to <market>.edeka.shop in a browser, then run edeka-pp-cli auth import --cdp <url> (or --file cookies.json)
Run 'edeka-pp-cli markets select <subdomain>' once, or set EDEKA_MARKET=<subdomain>

troubleshoots.symptom: basket call returns an HTML page instead of JSON
troubleshoots.fix: The shop's form token expired; run the command again (the CLI fetches a fresh token once automatically)

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent or a person shops at an EDEKA market that sells online on edeka.shop: finding markets, reading offers, searching products with prices, filling the basket, choosing a pickup slot and placing the order after an explicit yes.
anti_triggers: Do not use it for EDEKA's national flyer site edeka.de or the EDEKA app; it only speaks the per-market shops on edeka.shop
Do not use it to place an order without the customer's explicit confirmation
Do not use it to cancel an order; the customer contacts the market
Do not use it for online card or direct-debit payment; it supports pay-at-handover methods only

recipes.explanation: Compact offer rows for an agent reply.

recipes.explanation: Reserves the earliest pickup slot and prints slot, payment, items and total from the shop review page without ordering; needs items in the basket. Add --confirm --expect-total <total_cents> only after the customer said yes.
